comment: Independent occupation route: a Valkyrie starts counted searching with seven Passes_walls turns, outside the source warning range. Five- and three-turn ordinary warnings leave occupation running; six searches leave timeout one for the separate expiry owner. The original Monk setup was unsuitable because a nearby monster stopped searching before a warning; this fresh setup changes the role/speed and level generation.
